description:
Shin-woong hates his own face so terribly that he always keeps it covered; with no family and no friends, the only thing he knows how to do is pump gas into cars.

Sang-hyeop, a man who willingly showed kindness to a stranger on a cold night, was like a small spark suddenly appearing on a snow-swept, blizzard-bitten mountain.

*“You’re the first person who’s ever been this nice to me.”*

In front of the cross at a church he visited with an acquaintance, Shin-woong prays, hoping to see Sang-hyeop again.

*“I’ll clean thoroughly. I won’t make a sound. I’ll skip dinner. Today, I won’t eat anything at all.”*

Surprisingly, the wish—which had only been an earnest muttering to himself—comes true overnight.

*“It’s because of my prayer that Sang-hyeop came to me. So I have to keep that promise.”* *(Source: Lezhin, translated)*
